description: Find Sentry issues related to an issue: likely duplicates with a similar stack trace in the same project, other errors in the same trace, and the error issues behind a metric alert. Returns each related issue with its status and why it's related. Use it before resolving or ignoring an issue. It doesn't compare titles or error messages.

limit.description: Maximum related issues per relation type.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

types.description: Relation types to return; all when omitted. similar_stacktrace: likely duplicates. same_trace: errors in the same trace, often the other side of a request. contributing: for a metric issue, the error issues behind it.

name: find_related_issues

relatedIssues.description: Issues matched by more relation types first.

relations.description: One entry per relation type that matched the issue.

score.description: similar_stacktrace only: how similar the stack traces are, from 0 to 1.

reporter.description: Who submitted a feedback issue. Null for other issues.

relationTypes.description: Whether each requested relation type ran.

status.description: ok: it ran, so no issues of this type means none were found. not_applicable: it doesn't apply to this issue. unavailable: it failed.

traceId.description: same_trace only: the trace that was searched.

title: Find Related Issues
